name: Finale Mortar Rack
description: Five-row fan rack, 5×5 tubes (25 per unit). Build two identical racks for Commander finale shells 47–96 (50 total). Center row vertical; each row outward is tilted halfway between center and outside on that side.

layout.axes: +X = left–right across rows (fan), +Y = front–back along tubes in a row, +Z = up
layout.notes: Five rows span X. Five tubes per row along Y. Two racks side by side or staged for transport.

angles.notes: Outer row ±12° from vertical. Inner rows ±6°. Same angles on both racks.

structure.walls: 1/2 in. plywood — 2 brown ends + 6 green dividers + 4 blue mid rows per rack; 4 top dowels (2× 2 in. + 2× 1.5 in. OD)
